rules.candidates3and4: All existing three-anchor source-matched verse rows; candidate=false flags word-shape review, not source mismatch.
rules.candidates5_28_29: Only existing three-anchor sameRecording=true verse rows.
rules.previousComparison: Only when immediately preceding verse belongs to the same candidate set and inherits the same verified offset.
rules.nextComparison: Only when immediately following verse belongs to the same candidate set and inherits the same verified offset.
rules.overlap: Half-open intervals; no auditory boundary certification.
